fish.fishVendor: Hello little one, are you here for the fish? Here you go! Take them to Dinotown before Madam Squyd's party is ruined.
fish.mmeSeyche: Ooooohhhh, thank you! This meal is going to be a success thanks to you! Make sure you return to Grandpa Joe to receive your reward!
fish.papyjoe: Madam Squyd is really pleased with you, here's your reward!

dog.mmeducraft1: Hello young man! Nioof-Nioof, my lovely little poodle has disappeared! I punished him for an accident and now I can't find him! Please help me find him, I miss him so much! I'm sure he couldn't climb these mountains with his tiny legs, he probably went to the South.
dog.nioufniouf: You've found Nioof-Nioof! Take him back to Lady Ducraft!
dog.mmeducraft2: My dear Nioof-Nioof!!! Please forgive me, I'm sorry for being mean! Thank you so much, young man. Return to that old fuddy-duddy Grandpa Joe to claim your reward!
dog.papyjoe: Argh... That old hag, her time will come! Anyway, this is for you.

kilgou.papyjoe: Well done, thanks to you the Hills are somewhat peaceful once again!

kilwlf.papyjoe: Well done, with that they shouldn't harm the goats for a while!

kilglu.papyjoe: Thanks, it's a fantastic specimen. Here's your reward!

kilgnt.papyjoe: Ooooooh! That was close! Thanks, you've really helped me out. I'll make sure to tell the King about your services while we play golf tomorrow.

kilcoq.papyjoe: Ah! Fantastic! I'll embellish the story a bit to make it truly epic! This will surely please the King!

fflow.pureWater: You get some Pure Water to water the rose bush...
fflow.mmeSeyche: Ooh thanks little one! My rose bush will now regain its beautiful colors! Return to Grandpa Joe, he'll give you your reward...
fflow.papyjoe: The charming Madam Squyd sends her appreciation for your work. You deserve your reward!

kbook.kbook: You find the recipe book, "100 Ways To Cook a Korgon", written and illustrated by One-Eyed Gorak
kbook.mmeSeyche: Thank you so much little one! I'll be experimenting with different Korgon recipes, don't hesitate to come by from time to time and try them!
kbook.papyjoe: Bravo! Madam Squyd sent me a piece of grilled Korgon to thank me. It's delicious!

msg.timbre: Well done! You've found the stamps, return them to Grandpa Joe as soon as possible!
msg.papyjoe: Fantastic! I can send my letter now! Here you go, take these stamps, you really deserve them...

lettre.mmeSeyche: Hello young Dinoz master, what have you brought me this time? What's that you've got there? A letter from Grandpa Joe? .... Bring him this in response quick!
lettre.papyjoe: What's this?! A reply?! Already! GREAT! She has accepted my invitation to dinner. I'm not too old to show her what a real man is made of!

kilpir.sophie: Oh! You're so kind! Thank you for bringing me these delicious Piranhoz for my birthday! Give Mister Bao a kiss from me!
kilpir.bob: I like giving presents ... here, take this as a reward.

troc.marchand: This banana looks delicious! I'll give you my kite in exchange!
troc.amoureux: Pfff ... I'm on my way to the Fountain of Youth, if you would like, I'll give you this brand-new engagement ring in exchange for your kite.
troc.bijoutier: What! I can't believe it! This ring is part of an ancient royal collection! I'll give you the most valuable thing I own in exchange for the ring, my villa on Totem Island! Take the keys, you can't refuse!
troc.touriste: I am sick of this SSS...swamp!!!!! This is the third time our Motor-Home has got stuck in the mud. What a stupid idea to go on vacation IN A SWAMP! What? A villa on Totem Island? Of course, I'll exchange it for my Motor-Home!
troc.artiste: Fan-ta-stic! I'm so happy! Look at these faces! It's a work of art! What? How can it be trashy? You don't even understand art! My work is easily worth the same as a motor-home. I'll exchange it with you!
troc.dame: I heard you're looking for a coat rack. I'll trade it for whatever you have... wait, what is that? "Faces"? It looks like nothing... it can't be worth much. Besides, I've never heard of "Picassi". Don't worry, you can still have the coat rack in exchange.
troc.bob: You found my coat rack? I hope this little journey has shown you that most valuable treasures have to be earned!

kilksk.bob: Well Done! You successfully sealed the Kazkadine leak in the Underwater Dome!

kilang.marchand: Umm? You're here on behalf of Mr Bao, looking for vinegar? Here, I have this old Chateau BrutForce which is perfect for cooking with.
kilang.pecheur: Are you looking for Mr Bao's friend? I think he went to visit Madam Squyd in Dinotown.
kilang.mmeseyche: Ooooh the cute little Dinoz!!! What? You're looking for Mr Bao's friend? He went to see old Grandpa Joe, they had important things to talk about!
kilang.adam: Yum! Eeloz with vinegar!! I love this dish! Sorry I didn't wait for you at Frish Port. I'll tell Bob to give you a reward!
kilang.bob: You're walking around during a mission? Adam told me everything. Here, take this, it's for you.

bigpch.bob: Fantastic! I can now exterminate the others on my own using my feet, thanks for your help.

rally1.etape: You pass the finish line, now return to Mr Bao Bob!
rally1.bob: Congratulations on finishing the Rally. Here's your prize.

rally2.etape1: You pass the first Rally checkpoint, now you have to go to the University!
rally2.etape2: You pass the second checkpoint, now return to Mr Bao Bob!
rally2.bob: Congratulations on finishing the Rally. Here's your prize.

rally3.etape1: You pass the first Rally checkpoint, now you have to go to BrutForce!
rally3.etape2: You pass the second Rally checkpoint, now you have to go to the Basalt Slopes!
rally3.etape3: You pass the third checkpoint, now return to Mr Bao Bob!
rally3.bob: Congratulations on finishing the Rally. Here's your prize.

rally4.etape: You pass the Rally checkpoint, now return to Mr Bao Bob as soon as possible!
rally4.bob: Congratulations on finishing the Rally. Here's your prize.

tour.etape1: Congratulations on passing the first checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is located in BrutForce. Good luck!
tour.etape2: Congratulations on passing the second checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is in the Precipitous Hills. Good luck up there!
tour.etape3: Congratulations on passing the third checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is in Lavapit. Good luck climbing the Big All-Hot!
tour.etape4: Congratulations on passing the fourth checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is in the Korgons' Camp in Grumhel Forest. Avoid being slowed down by the monsters!
tour.etape5: Congratulations on passing the fifth checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour. The next checkpoint is at the Edge of the Forest! Be careful! don't get lost on the Dark Path...
tour.etape6: Congratulations on passing the sixth checkpoint of the Dinoland Tour! Now return to Bao Bob to win the Tour!
tour.bob: Bravo! That was a great performance. Here, take this, it's a reward for your success!

kswim.list: Dian Korgsey's list shows that she really needs some tools. You can find them at the forges of the Big All-Hot.
kswim.tools: You pick up a pouch of tools. "Branches from the Ashpouk Ruins" are also on the list.
kswim.wood: You pick up a few charred branches. Last on the list is "a charm".
kswim.grigri: The Shaman grins and gives you one of his lucky charms. Thanks!
kswim.camp: Perfect! I've got everything I need! Here, take these Korgon fins as promised!

rivals.trophee: You pick up a few Korgon claws to use as a trophy for the Northern Korgons...
rivals.camp: Ah! Good idea, Korgon Claws! The Northern Korgons seem to like it ... here, take this for your trouble.

kfood.branch: Better to not stay here for too long: you cut down a few branches and quickly move away from the tree.
kfood.tree: You notice an odd-looking tree with grey leaves which smells like stale tobacco ... this must be The Ashy Fikoia! But wait! while you're preparing to take a few branches, you hear noises coming from the undergrowth...
kfood.camp: The Korgons will love that, thanks a lot!

poison.seve: You pick up some Oozing Mordicus, tree sap with a disgusting taste. This will be ideal for our trap.
poison.trap: Noooo! The Fikoia has disappeared! The Southern Korgons must have got here before us!
poison.ambush: While travelling in the Wild Jungle, a group of Korgons ambushes you! You've got to get rid of them to continue...
poison.leaves1: The large tracks on the ground indicate that something very heavy has passed this way from Jumin River ... the tracks lead towards the south.
poison.leaves2: The tracks end here ... judging by the growls coming from the bushes, someone or something has been waiting for you to arrive!
poison.fiquoia: The Ashy Fikoia is hidden under a pile of banana tree leaves. You'll have to drag it back to camp...
poison.dian: Here you are! It's a shame that they cut down The Ashy Fikoia ... it seems like the work of the Southern Korgons, without doubt ... well, we can't travel up river with it. Hide it here, it'll be safe enough. We'll meet up again at the camp.
poison.hidefiquoia: You hide the tree under some banana tree leaves.
poison.camp: It's quite sad what happened to this Fikoia, it's such a rare tree... Thanks for all your help, we won't forget it!

init1.inscriptions: Hmmm ... do you understand anything? I don't. If only we had a dictionary it would be easy!
init1.dictionnaire: You find an old mould-covered dictionary in the library shelves. It's titled "Ashpouk-Dinozish, Little Lamousse Edition".
init1.inscriptions_decrypt: You start to decipher the mysterious Ashpouk inscriptions. After many hours of hard work, you finally understand everything: it seems as though it's an ancient recipe.
init1.shaman: Mmmm ... It looks like a recipe ... the famous legendary Archelion Merguez. Cool ... I'll cook some immediately. Congratulations on translating it, you really are skilled.

init2.claw: You pick up two large baby Archelion claws. They need to be sharpened.
init2.forgeron: You need to sharpen some Archelion claws? You know that it's dangerous to walk around with those?! Even though it scares them slightly, it will attract ALL the other monsters!! Great job!! Some are already coming.
init2.garde: You're responsible for this mess?! Don't expect any kindness! What's that?! The Shaman rascal sent you? He wants an Archelionscarer? They're easy to make, you just have to ... OH! Watch out! Others are coming!!
init2.garde2: Well give me your claws so I can get rid of them! To scare the Archelion, apply this strong ointment each morning. I warn you, it has a very strong smell.
init2.shaman: Oh! I didn't know the claws did that! I'm so sorry! I hope that the Forges Guard didn't make too much of a fuss. Anyway, thanks for the ointment. I'll go and see if it works. Meanwhile, take my Strategy Guide as a “Thank You”.

burn.cinder: The ashes left by these Flamelets have a strange smell, like ... barbecue. This needs to be investigated.
burn.artisan: Flamelets that smell like barbecue you say? Sorry, I've got no idea. But the smell is stronger in the west. Try looking in that direction.
burn.sniff: Sniff, sniff... There's no doubt about it! The smell of frying is the same as those Flamelets ashes you just fought! No time to waste, you'll have to fight to clean up the area...
burn.seek: It seems these Flamelets came from the Merguez seller's barbecue. The Soft Shaman must be informed about this!
burn.shaman: Your actions have restored the region's equilibrium.....for now. It's a good start, but we have to do something about this barbecue business. Until then, here's a little reward for all your help.

barbec.sbranch: You find  the first ingredient on the ground: a dry, almost burnt, branch.
barbec.ecaille: You approach the huge Dorogon, but it gives you a dark-and-icy look. Better find another way to get a scale!
barbec.floor: You search the lair, but you only find broken scales.
barbec.search: Just outside the Venerable's lair, you see a beautiful and shiny scale tucked away under a pile of rocks. That solves your problem nicely.
barbec.basalte: You spend hours searching for a piece of yellow basalt. You finally find one on the slopes.
barbec.mix: You use your hammer to grind the ingredients into a fine powder. That'll do!
barbec.use: As soon as you throw the mix into the flames, streaks of multicoloured lightning shoot out from every direction and crackle all around the barbecue. But as quickly as they appeared, the streaks of lightning disappear and the barbecue returns to normal. Only the sound of faint crackles and pops reminds you that anything happened.
barbec.shaman: Well done! The new mix should reduce the effects of the magic barbecue without altering the taste of the delicious Merguez. Take this tamed little Flamelet as a reward.

joke.rfish: You pick up the worst-smelling fish you can find, including a horrible-smelling Fetid-Fish!
joke.strap: You place the foul-smelling fish leftovers in the drawers of Professor Eugene's desk. Ha ha!
joke.shaman: Yes! That's perfect! I never thought you would hide a Fetid-Fish in his office. How cunning!

defend.garde1: Attention soldier! We have to hold on! Hold your positions! Monsters incoming!
defend.garde2: Thanks for your help soldier! I've seen many monsters hiding at the Slopes, we must pursue and kill them this time!
defend.eclaireur: They're hiding in the caverns at the edge of the Basalt Slopes sir. You'll have to flush them out one by one!
defend.banner: You find the war banner worn by the monsters chief! This should please the Forges Guard...
defend.garde3: Good job soldier! Thanks to your heroic efforts, victory is ours. Give this recommendation letter to the Soft Shaman, he'll know how to reward you.
defend.shaman: The letter is very complimentary about you. It seems you more than deserve your reward! As you found the Monsters' War Banner, I've added a little something as a bonus.

shipmt.convoy1: Help!! I had to deliver an important package to the top of the volcano, but a group of aggressive goblins attacked me! They've stolen my package and I don't know what to do. I'll be fired unless I get the package back!
shipmt.convoy2: Thank you so much, you've saved my life! Hey! I think that my package is over there!
shipmt.pickup: You find the package near a goblin. Unfortunately it's empty! You have to find out what happened to its contents.
shipmt.convoy3: I saw loads of goblins running towards the north. Go and find them, then meet up with me again at the Lavapit once you have found the contents!
shipmt.sound: You hear noises coming from the shadows of the cavern. It must be the goblins you are searching for!
shipmt.pickMerchandise: You pick up some gourds of multicolored powders, these must be the items that the Soft Shaman ordered from Grandpa Joe.
shipmt.convoy4: Ah, you've found the contents of my package! Great! I don't know how to thank you. I will speak highly of you to the Soft Shaman!
shipmt.shaman: My courier just delivered my order. He explained that he wouldn't have been able to deliver the package without your help! Take this potion and a little reward as a token of my gratitude!

sales.babioles: You get some old-looking objects from the ruins to flog as souvenirs at Dinotown market.
sales.market: You spend the next hour selling pieces of rubble and broken combat gear as souvenirs to the highest bidder. Everyone is bidding on the items! The Shaman was right, it seems you'll be able to sell all your stock without any difficulty at all.

ritual.instruction: You take the letter from the Congregation. The instructions state that you must begin the ritual by killing a Goblin in a single combat...
ritual.nextInstruction: The letter says that you must chant: "SHAMANA MANA!"
ritual.shamana: SHAMANA MANA! ... Ok, well, let's go on to the next instruction...
ritual.donga: DONGA! DONGAAA! ... All that's left now is to chant on the western face of the volcano.
ritual.rock: You throw a stone into the huge crater to complete the Ridiculous Ritual.
ritual.shaman: Judging by the forlorn look on your face, you probably understand why I had no desire to do this stupid ritual. Anyway, thanks for the favor, here's something to make up for your trouble.

hiero.hieroglyphes: You copy out the Hieroglyphics using the scroll given to you by the Shaman.
hiero.shaman: Hmmm ... very interesting ... Hmmm ... Here's something that should gobsmack that old grumpy clown from the University! Thanks for your help!

pigeon.profLetter: I see that this crazy magician has found something else to bother me with! Hmm ... Hmm ... OH! Oh my god! It can't be! I have to be certain before I can comment any further. Show this letter to my dear friend Doctor Yolande on Waïkiki Island immediately!
pigeon.yolande: Wow! This came from the caverns of Deep Gorges you say? It's incredible! You must show this to Mister Shovel, The Brutforce Archeologist.
pigeon.foundArcheo: Archeologist Shovel doesn't seem to be here. Apparently he is working on a construction site in the Deep Gorges.
pigeon.archeo: Oh ... That's funny, this looks a lot like the notes I left on the cavern walls. What's that you say? The Shaman thought it was ancient texts?! Of course not! I wrote those, they're my personal notes.
pigeon.shaman: Aargh! I was sure that we had stumbled upon a historical discovery! Don't worry ... thanks for your help in any case. Here, take this as a reward.

unmute.fwater: You fill the empty gourd with a small amount of Jumin River water. You've found running water!
unmute.mwater: You add a small amount of Sticky Swamp water to the half empty gourd. It smells very bad...
unmute.pwater: You add a small amount of Fountain clear water to the gourd and refresh yourself at the same time.
unmute.bwater: You fill the gourd with a small amount of boiling water from the Gorges. It's hot!
unmute.racine: The old tree's leaves suddenly shake in every direction and a soothing light fills the jungle all around you...
unmute.garde: The old tree bows down to you... It slowly shakes his leaves, some beautiful fruits then fall at your feet.

orchid.pickwater: You fill the gourd with Jumin River water.
orchid.worchid: You pour the contents of the gourd onto a magnificent flower, "The Orchid Child". Immediately, it lights up like a thousand fires and some beautiful dew drops form on its graceful leaves.
orchid.talkingorchide: What?! What are you looking at? You've never seen an Orchid blooming before?! You have nothing else to do? Go away, leave me alone!!
orchid.garde: You place the gourd at the bottom of the tree. A big fruit drops from the upper branches and falls close to you with a thud.

licens.garde: Many fruits fall from the tree and land around you...

king.yell: Your call is too weak! It wouldn't even scare a Korgon... You need to do better than that!
king.talkingorchide: Still here are we stupid? Why are you looking at me like that, have you got a problem?
king.pickorchid: Without paying attention, you uproot the orchid and take it with you. It shouts insults at you whilst using all its strength to try and break free.
king.plantorchid: You quickly replant the Orchid Child. While you are leaving, you can still hear it screaming at you... That should be enough to scare the tourists off!
king.garde: A fruit falls near you. While you are bending over to pick it up, a big purse full of gold falls out of nowhere and hits you on the head! Plunk!

wishes.tosscoin: You throw a coin into the Falls and wait a few minutes... Nothing happens so you decide to grant the wish yourself by eliminating the population of monsters on your own.
wishes.garde: Many fruits fall from the tree...

newplt.benevole1: Hello! Are you here to help me clear the rockfall? I have a big problem at the moment... Monsters always disturb me whilst I'm working... Can you help me?
newplt.liftrock1: You pick up your jack and start to clear the rockfall... While you are working, you hear a disturbing growl behind you...
newplt.benevole2: No time to waste, keep clearing!
newplt.liftrock2: Even using the jack, it still takes you hours to clear the rockfall. At the end you manage to free the trees and plants that were buried under the rocks.
newplt.benevole3: I will stay here to water the surviving plants. Report back to the Forest Warden for me.
newplt.garde: Two big fruits fall from the tree into a bush near you...

gshop.bucket: You find a little branch in the bucket...
gshop.garde: The text on the wooden sign has changed! It now reads: "Keep the blossoming branch as a proof of our gratitude."

seqact.auree: I can't hear any more growling coming from the path ... that's a good sign, isn't it?

toxic.pickfigo: You pick a blistered and sticky flower...
toxic.pickpuru: The Purulent emits a small cloud of suspicious, foul-smelling pollen....mmmm....very strange, better pick this one.
toxic.pickvisqueuse: You find a big greenish water lily lying in a puddle of stagnant water.
toxic.auree: These are perfect! ... I'll try to find out which one causes my allergies ... Take this as a “Thank You”.

hucure.pickherbs: You take Nicolas' toxic plants. It seems that he tried to infuse them...
hucure.moinemedecin: You gave him a Furuncle Figonicia? A Black Purulent?! A Mud Viscous!! Oh my my... We have to hurry! Bring me some coral powder immediately!
hucure.pickCoral: You pick up a piece of broken coral: that should do.
hucure.moinemedecin2: Bring me some Korgon fangs from the Sinister Path and some Tawny-Bat wings from the north.
hucure.pickTeeth: You pick up some Korgon fangs.
hucure.pickWings: You pick up a nice pair of Tawny-Bat wings...
hucure.moinemedecin3: Perfect! I can cook a delicious meal. Hmmm, sorry? Ahh! That's right you came for a remedy didn't you. Worry not, I have a crate full of remedy, take what you need. Shall I keep some soup for you?
hucure.pickMedecine: You take with you a few antidote vials for Nicolas Mulot, we never know...
hucure.auree: Glou glou! Fanks ... Jwust hopfe it wiwll work ... Take fis pofion aws aw szign of gratifuwde.

map.drawMap: You set up on an old tree stump to start drawing the map of the surrounding area ... Suddenly, a hideous Tawny-Bat comes out of nowhere and grabs your notepad with its jaws! It flies away immediately and sits on a high branch...
map.catchBat: You are sure you hear the bat giggling on it's perch ... you shake a branch to make the Bat fall, but it flies away and escapes into the jungle!
map.bat: The tawny-bat finally settles on the top of a huge tree! It calmly stares down at you.
map.launchRock: You've hit the bull's eye! The Tawny-Bat cries and your notepad falls to the bottom of the tree. Irritated, the bat crawls to your feet and glares at you...
map.pickNote: You've finally got your notepad back!
map.redraw: You finish drawing the map, making sure to keep your guard up this time!
map.auree: It's not bad at all! I'll study this map in order to prepare my extreme expedition.

bckpck.extremFisher: A bag pack y'say? Nope I don't remember fishing that! Y'a should mayb'see if it was carried away toward the swamp by the current?
bckpck.alguae: Ah, I remember!! It was a very nice backpack, it was stuck in a bog! I gave it to one of my cousins so that he could carry his stones, it's really practical! Gosh!
bckpck.interogateMinors: You ask the miners some questions, they point to another miner...
bckpck.minorHalt: Yup. I know what you're talking about. But I don't have it anymore. (He spits on the ground) Yup. I only had it for a couple of days. I sent it to my cousin in Frish Port. I thought he could use it as a good fishing net. (He spits again)
bckpck.afraidFisher: The bag? I still have it! But it's in terrible condition! I can fix it for you if you would like ... but I need a bobbin of thread and sewing needles. You can buy these items in Dinotown I think.
bckpck.findBobine: You check all the Dinotown shops to find the Sewing Material. You finally find a sewing shop...
bckpck.couturiere: Good day to you Dinoz Master, welcome to my shop! Needle and thread? Yes I have some, but they're not cheap ... if I agree to give it to you, will you do me a favour? I live near the fountain and every evening my house is attacked by monstrous Giant Chickens! If you help me I'll give you the material for free.
bckpck.couturiere2: Thank you so much for all your help! Here's the material as I promised...
bckpck.afraidFisher2: Ah, you brought exactly what I need to patch up your bag. (One hour later..........) Done!
bckpck.auree: You won't believe this, I just received a spare backpack! I ordered it in anticipation of my journey ... No problem, I have a great idea! I'll take back my old backpack and give you the new one! It's a deal?

rodriz.seekrice: After searching the Swamp for several hours, you finally found an area full of Amnesiac Rice, a rare variety of Rice with amazing properties! The only problem is that hundreds of Pirhanoz are protecting the entrance. You'll have to find a way past them!
rodriz.pickrice: Congratulations! You've found some Amnesiac Rice!
rodriz.forges: To be honest, I didn't need the Amnesiac Rice, sorry! I only needed a little bit of lightning energy to recharge my cape ... here, take this as a reward. You can keep the rice too, I don't need it anymore.

rodlif.forges: Not bad for a weak Dinoz from Dinotown ... here take this!

skully1.ptitJoe1: Uncle Moulder? It's been a long time since I've heard from him. If you want to know more, bring me three Goblin Merguez from the Big All-Hot!
skully1.ptitJoe2: Thanks! (munch, munch) all I know is that Uncle Moulder loved his wife. He engraved a message for her on the Fountain of Youth.
skully1.readMessage: On one of the engravings on the Fountain of Youth, you read the following message: "I'll be waiting for you at the place we first met"
skully1.skull: Thanks. This information is priceless. My dear Moulder can't be far away, we'll be together again soon!

skully2.touriste: I'm sick of this sh... Swamp!!!!! It's the third time our Motor-Home has got stuck here, what a dumb idea to come on VACATION IN A SWAMP!!! What? Have I seen someone called Moulder? Ah! Yes, he was going to an Anonymous Eeloz Association meeting! Be careful is you decide to go too, they can be very touchy....
skully2.fish1: This is a good place to fish. Fish come here to see the levitating monks ... A guy named Moulder? I know him well: He went to Piranhoz Bay to go fishing. Take care man, those guys bite.
skully2.fish2: Moulder? He left, he told me he was going back to wait for his wife at the Swamp. Poor guy, he hasn't seen her in years. If I were him I'd be happy about that! Ha Ha!
skully2.panneau: A sign seems to have been placed near a bed of waterlilies. The sign reads: "I'm sick of these mosquitos, meet me where I declared my love for you. Moulder."
skully2.skull: Oh! My dear Moulder! I feel closer to you than ever!

skully3.bao?: What??? Miss Bao?? No ... don't you know who I am? .......... If you're looking for my sister, she's with the grandson of the ArchDorogon: "The Venerable" as he likes to be called nowadays. If his father finds out that he likes to be called that, there'll be trouble.
skully3.missBao: What??? Miss Bao?? It's been years since anybody has called me that. Please call me by my first name young man, Babe.
skully3.baoBabe1: If you want my advice, I'm afraid you're going to have to wait for a while. I need to finish my game of Draughts with the ArchDorogon's grandson. His grandfather made me promise to visit his grandson from time to time to keep him company. Why don't you go and hunt some goblins whilst you wait?
skully3.baoBabe2: Finished! I beat him hands down. Hi hi hi! I love to make him lose his temper, he's so cute when his nostrils flare and start to blow vapor! You said you needed some advice?
skully3.baoBabe3: Right. The solution to this kind of problem is really simple: Moulder must keep a piece of Skully with him at all times so that he never forgets her. See you later young man!
skully3.skull: Oh! Here's a nice solution for my problem! Here, take this, now you'll never forget the way to the cemetery, nor your dear Skully!

skully4.merguez: A strange customer? Yeah, there was a thin-looking guy who was here a while ago, he was letting out a lot of sighs. I remember he was on his way to the ruins. Be careful! There are some strange tourists around.
skully4.lookBoat: After searching for a while, you finally find a strange-looking boat that matches your description.
skully4.freeMan: Thhh Thhaannkksss!! I hahahave hahad fefefear you know! Moulder?? Nono, my nananame is Jean-Claude. I am a friefriend of the mermerguez seller! Ththanks anayway fofor your help!
skully4.merguez2: You saved Jean-Claude? Ah!! Thanks a lot. Those steppes bandits ruined the Ruins' tourist industry I don't know how to thank you! Moulder? He promised to come back if I prepared him some Napalm shrimp, but I don't know the recipe.
skully4.skull: I can feel Moulder coming closer, thanks a lot for your help my young friend!

skully5.skully1: Well, first of all, I need some shrimp. You can find some at the Underwater Dome Market! Go quickly!
skully5.shrimpSeller: I'm sorry but following recent fraudulent transactions, I no longer accept gold coins as payment for my shrimp. You'll have to bring me 3 Treasury Notes....
skully5.giveTreasure: Thanks, here are your shrimp! Bon appétit!
skully5.skully2: Oh oh oh! Ma-gni-fi-cent! These shrimp are so fresh! Now that we've got some shrimp, we need to gather the next ingredient. Some Napalm. To make it, we need some good quality lava.
skully5.shaman: Some Napalm? Mmm ... you'll need to make a mixture of half-lava, half-flamelets. We have loads of lava here, so all you need to get are 5 boxes of Flamelets in order to prepare the mixture.
skully5.giveSos: Glou glou! Here you are, some low density Napalm is ready and waiting for you.
skully5.skully3: Oh! Superb Napalm! But the recipe can't be completed without adding a vitally important ingredient. Some fatty Korgon's hair! You can often find some near the Big All-Hot, but make sure you don't end up stealing someone's dinner or else you'll live to regret it!
skully5.skully4: Stir stir! Here we are! A magnificent dish of Napalm Shrimp!
skully5.skull: Thanks for your help! I can't wait to see my dear Moulder again!

skully_end.merguez: Ooooohh!! So these are the famous Napalm Shrimp?!? Let's see ... mmmm ... it's missing a bit of fat but it's still incredibly succulent. Without a doubt Moulder will arrive soon. Ahhhh! Look who's coming!
skully_end.skull: Ooooooooooooooohhh! He's back, he's back! My dear Moulder is back!!! Thank you so much for all your help young man!!

description.perle: Using the pearl your Dinoz can recover health at the Fountain of Youth each day.
description.pteroz: The Pteroz' trophy is awarded to players who have defeated the strange Pteroz. It also unlocks Pteroz in the Dinoz shop.
description.hippo: The Hippoclamp's Trophy is awarded to players who have defeated the wild Hippoclamp. It also unlocks Hippoclamps in the Dinoz Shop.
description.rocky: The Rocky's Trophy is awarded to players who have defeated the sleeping Rocky. It also unlocks Rockies in the Dinoz Shop.
description.quetzu: The Quetzu's Trophy is awarded by Mandragore to players who have defeated the Archdorogon Grizorg. It alose unlocks Quetzus in the Dinoz Shop.
description.labowi: The Smog's Trophy was given by Professor Henderson during the Corrupt Lab Crisis. Unfortunately, only one smog could be created during this quest.
description.tour: This yellow jersey awards you for your beautiful Dinoland's tour ! You are now part of Dinoland's greatest explorers.
description.vener: The Eye of the Venerable is an extremely rare item. Only the greatest warriors can obtain it! It is said to have incredibly powerful magical properties...
description.taurus: You helped Bao Bob push the mighty Infernal Moueffe Taurus into the depths of the Dark World. You are not going to see it again, your courage is already beginning to cross the borders of Dinoland.
description.belius: You have defeated the powerful Belius, the infernal Santaz. He has been sent back to the depths of the Dark World. This trophy allows you to unlock 3 additional races of demon Dinoz in the Demon Shop.
description.scorp: You expelled the powerful infernal Winks Scorpus. He is back in the depths of the Dark World.
description.msg: This unlimited dinozian postal services approved stamp's stock validates your Dinotown trip
description.magnet: You have been gifted this negative magnetite shard by the Rockies' king himself ! Who knows what kind of mysterious powers it holds...
description.plume: This feather, gifted from someone far away, allows editing player's presentation.
description.kaura: This aura allows you accessing the totem island and finding - maybe - Kabuki having survived the Great Cataclysm !
description.demon: This old scroll will allow you to access the demonic shop at the downfall Cemetery !
description.pmi: The Little Illustrated Missionary allows you to have access at any time to the list of missions completed and remaining to be done for your Dinoz.
description.pda: The P.D.A. is a stone filled (surprisingly) with naturally formed technology that allows a master to have an overview of all his Dinoz at a glance. The Diamantite on the other hand is just for show.
description.fdjv1: This trophy is a thanks to the players who made a long journey to the 2010 edition of the Gaming Festival to meet the shadow puppeteers!
description.dico1: A very old book, maybe it will help you decipher something? Unfortunately for now, it is closed by a very complex lock. Does anyone know how to open it ? For now, it seems that no one can...
description.dicarb: A very old book, you managed to open it, it can now help decipher the Arboris language.
description.caush: A doll bearing the image of Mandragore, it can be used as a voodoo doll, a punching-ball or a pillow, it's up to you. It is in a pitiful state, the previous owner must have let off steam on it quite often.
description.fmedal: You have reconstructed the medallion which allows you to access a new part of the celestial island of Nimbao. You must find the correct place to use this medallion in order to use the portal correctly.
description.war1a: This necklace was forged from a rare mineral and it was awarded to the strongest warriors during the 1st Clan War!
description.war1b: Rumors say that by touching this strange stone you can go mad causing strange behavior. In any case the stone is very rare, reserved only for impressive Dinoz masters during the 1st Clan War!
description.war2a: This jewel, composed of three blood gems set in an aura of darkness, was awarded to the best tacticians during the 2nd Clan War!
description.war2b: A piece of uncut tawny-amber, a highly valuable rare material, offered to Dinoz who showed remarkable bravery during the 2nd Clan War!
description.war3a: Your talents as master builder of the castle have been recognized, and this enchanted trowel was awarded only to the best clans during the 3rd Clan War!
description.war3b: This highly valuable nail, made entirely from jade, was offered to masters who showed remarkable bravery during the 3rd Clan War!
description.war4a: This shield was given to Clans who crushed their enemies defenses during the 4th Clan War!
description.war4b: The stone of orientation was given to Clans who distinguished themselves during the 4th Clan War. The stone allows you to find your way in the caves, but it always indicates to turn left.
description.war5a: By repeatedly destroying the castles of your enemies during the 5th Clan War, you have finally found a perfectly preserved Goblin Skull, congratulations !
description.war5b: This rare magical bell was used to broadcast your accomplishments during the 5th Clan War. Perfect for impressing your friends, but unfortunately there is no 'OFF' switch...
description.warfa: This mug is bewitched by the spirit of a mog, which sings a ballad every hour to keep you awake, therefore allowing you to defend your clan at any time. It's a fitting reward for your awesome exploits in the 5th Clan War, even if there's a decent chance it'll end up gathering dust in a cupboard.
description.warfb: It is said that Chokokookies are the Dorogons' snack of choice. You have been awarded this to thank you for your impressive contribution to the 5th Clan War. You have tried it, and it tastes like roast Korgon, only sweeter.
description.warga: Gold armor - commonly called Arm'or' is very useful for parades and festivals. Unfortunately it's not very effective in fights. It was only awarded to winners of the 7th Clan War.
description.wargb: You have received the Demyon Boots for your participation in the 7th Clan War. No longer will your Dinoz get blisters on their feet while attacking enemy castles.
description.warha: A gold ring, studded with three rubies "one ring to beat them all" is engraved in small writing on the inside. Only the winners of the 8th Clan War deserve to wear it!
description.warhb: A pale blue ring, given as a reward to clan members following their exploits during the 8th Clan War... Legends tell of certain people going crazy upon wearing it...
description.waria: For winning the 9th Clan War, you have been awarded this samurai helmet! Its previous owner was a powerful shogun who won countless battles, the helmet striking fear in the very hearts of the enemies who saw it. Unfortunately, it is just too shiny to be worn in battles.
description.warib: The ghost samurai helmet is reputed to guard the souls of warriors who fought against it on the battlefield. it is the proof of your considerable achievements in the 9th Clan War. However, these helmets are now purely decorative, as it is impossible to wear the helmet without hearing the screams of the ghosts within...
description.waric: You have found a helmet belonging to someone who participated in a great war. It is proof of your valiant conduct during the 9th Clan War. This helmet is of poor quality, so it's not that surprising that the soldier who wore it was defeated by their enemy.
description.warja: This sword holds a great secret. According to legend, it was broken during an epic combat in an ancient war. Its blade was forged in the purest crystallized mana. You have been awarded this sword for winning the 1st Mana War.
description.warjb: Having received sufficient quantities of mana during the 1st Mana War, the King authorized you to keep some in a sealed chest to reward you for your extraordinary efforts during these troubled times.
description.warjc: It is quite rare that a drop of Mana crystalises at the bottom of the storage reservoirs. Once this forms, the Mana can no longer be used as energy, but the object itself is sufficiently rare to attract dedicated collectors. It is a beautiful trophy which was awarded to you for your valiant performance in the 1st Mana War.
description.warka: Baby Djinn is a powerful being, valuable ally on the battlefield, it will decimate your enemies when fully grown... which should be in a few hundred years! You have been awarded MiniDjinn for winning the 2nd Mana War.
description.warkb: Baby Ifrit is hot-blooded, and will engulf your enemies in flames when fully grown... which should be in a few hundred years! You have been awarded Minifrit for putting in an excellent performance in the 2nd Mana War!
description.warkc: A young shoot of the powerful Yggdrasil fell at your feet during a ferocious battle during the 2nd Mana War. Once fully grown, Miniggdra will get ever bigger and better, taking you even closer to legend status!
description.warla: This vestige of a bygone civilisation now floats aimlessly in the skies. The King has given it to you in the hope that you'll do the housework from time to time... Watch out though, the generator will only work for around a century, after which time the citadel will crash to earth on Dinoland. In any case, it has been given to you in recognition of your triumph in the 3rd Mana War.
description.warlb: You have won an unforgettable stay in the tower room of the extravagant Jade Palace, which offers magnificent views over all of Dinoland. This stay has been awarded to you in recognition of your performance in the 3rd Mana War!
description.warlc: The King has rewarded you with a stay in the unspoiled floating islands. You will have to tidy the place up a bit after you recover from the 3rd Mana War.
description.warma: The King's head chef has prepared his specialty for you. This hamburger is reserved exclusively for the elite warriors of the 4th Mana War. Only a few masters have ever tasted this culinary delight.
description.warmb: In recognition of a terrific performance in the 4th Great Mana War, the King's head chef has prepared one if the finest Gromster Nimbao Ribsteaks you will ever experience. Once you've sampled a few, you start to appreciate the effort required to transport the whole thing to Dinotown in one piece.
description.warmc: The giant chickens are not rare, but when the King's head chef gets a hold of one it becomes very much something out of the ordinary. This will delight your senses after a great effort in participating in the 4th Great Mana War.
description.warna: This unique relic, forged by the most famous blacksmith in Dinoland, pays tribute to a great Dinoz master. This was awarded to you for winning the 5th Mana War. The last war of the Epoqalypse!
description.warnb: Forged at the very heart of Dinoville Castle, this ring allows the wearer to see life through rose-tinted glasses and to smell of fish, it was awarded to you in recognition of your performance in the 5th Mana War. The last war of the Epoqalypse!
description.warnc: Never go to war without your belt on, and if you get starving, no problem, easily portable, it can even double as a pillow. Enjoy your prize for participating in the 5th Mana War. The last war of the Epoqalypse!
description.waroa: This portrait of a famous martial arts master (an old acquaintance of master Zenith it seems) comes to you for your victory in the 6th Mana War. May his face show you the way in battle.
description.warob: This portrait of a powerful martial arts master is offered to you for your valiant efforts in the 6th Mana War. If one day your paths should cross, do not accept anything he offers you to drink... Your life depends on it!
description.waroc: This portrait of an enigmatic man is offered to you for your active participation in the 6th Mana War. His advice is worth its weight in gold but his thoughts are impenetrable.
description.warpa: This miniature statue was fashioned on the image of an all powerful god. Did he create another world beyond the realm of Dinoland? Nobody knows… The destruction and creation of entire worlds, not mere castles, are his concern. It is given to you for having won the 7th Mana War.
description.warpb: This miniature statue is the embodiment of wisdom, intelligence and prudence. It is given to you as proof of your valor and courage during the 7th Mana War.
description.warpc: This miniature statue of an immense serpent signifies the eternal and the infinite. Just like your courage, it has no limits. It is given to you for your active participation in the 7th Mana War.
description.warqa: This little stuffy lights up the dark when you need him to. It's probably wise to avoid giving him a hug at this moment. It is given to you for your victory in the 8th Mana War.
description.warqb: Whatever you do, don't try and grab this stuffy by the tail! You'll regret it... The resourceful Dinoz masters will no doubt see his application as a portable lighter. It's offered to you for proving your valor during the 8th Mana War.
description.warqc: A living breathing sprinkler, this little stuffy is fantastic for those sweltering summer days, fill the pool or power your water fountain with this bubbling geyser of happiness. It's offered to you for your participation in the 8th Mana War!
description.warra: This lantern lights up in the dark when it senses danger. Keep it close to hand, it could help you in a distant war. It is given to you for your victory in the 9th Mana War!
description.warrb: Great for snatching a smoke break on those long watches on the wall of your clan castle. Might be useful for toasting marshmallows too. It is given to you for showing your worth in the 9th Mana War.
description.warrc: A nice little night light that will surely come in handy during those late night inter-clan role plays. It will forever remind you of the 9th Mana War...
description.warsa: This defensive military turret rewards your flamboyant victory in the 10th Mana War! Entirely reprogrammable, it should come in handy against any extraterrestrial invaders too...
description.warsb: This surveillance turret is a reward for your bravery during the 10th Manna War. Thanks to her smooth clean lines and modern design, she'll be at home in your lounge room.
description.warsc: This turret as sexy as it is merciless is a reward for your participation in the 8th Mana War. Also available in blue.
description.warta: This 240volt hammer rewards your outrageous victory in the 11th Mana War. Great for hammering nails or recharging a smartphone.
description.wartb: This axe is given to you in recognition for your bravery during the 11th Mana War. Forged in the heart of Mt Tongariro, it will resist the fire of your success.
description.wartc: This axe, direct from the colder regions of Dinoland seems to have spent a bit of time cutting up red fruits... You've earned it through your participation in the 11th Mana War.
description.warua: This little lump of ore is loaded with diamonds and represents your victory in the 12th Mana War! If you ever come across hard times you can always sell one or two of these shiny little rocks...
description.warub: This chest, sealed for all eternity, represents your bravery in the 12th Mana War! If you ever manage to get it open, who knows what you'll find in it...
description.waruc: A bit of the land of the Titans is given to you for your participation in the 12th Mana War! Let it serve as a warning to be vigilant of usurpers...
description.warva: This mithril-tipped shoe commemorates your incredible victory in the 13th Mana War.
description.warvb: This stealthy ninja footwear commemorates your bravery in the 13th Mana War.
description.warvc: This fashionable Spartan sandal symbolizes your courage in the 13th Mana War.
description.warwa: This diamond necklace commemorates your remarkable victory in the 14th Mana War.
description.warwb: This 6000-carat gold necklace commemorates your bravery in this 14th Mana War.
description.warwc: A moonstone necklace is the symbol of your courage in the 14th Mana War.
description.warxa: This grenade commemorates your resounding victory in the 15th Mana War.
description.warxb: This antique castor oil bomb commemorates your bravery in this 15th mana war.
description.warxc: This grenade filled with aromatic saltpeter is a symbol of your explosive courage in the 15th Mana War.
description.warya: This valiant heart commemorates your incredible victory in the 16th Mana War.
description.waryb: This divine eye commemorates your bravery in this 16th Mana War.
description.waryc: This battlefield kidney is a symbol of your courage in the 16th Mana War.
description.warza: This dark orb commemorates your incredible victory in the 17th Mana War.
description.warzb: This ice orb from Mont Blanc commemorates your bravery in this 17th Mana War.
description.warzc: This Greek fire orb is the symbol of your courage in the 17th Mana War.
description.ch1x1a: This cup was awarded to the winners of the Pro League in the 1st Clans Championship : only true champions have one!
description.ch1x1b: This cup was awarded to clans from the Pro League that made it to the final phases of the 1st Clans Championship: a reward for a truly impressive feat!
description.ch1x2a: This cup was awarded to the winners of the Intermediate League in the 1st Clans Championship: It is a prestigious distinction only given to solid players!
description.ch1x2b: This cup was awarded to clans from the Intermediate League that made it to the final phases of the 1st Clans Championship: not an easy award to win!
description.ch2x1a: This cup is to reward the participants of the Pro League in the 2nd Championship of the Clans: reserved for players with a thirst for blood and action!
description.ch2x2a: This cup honors the winners of the 2nd Medium League Clan Championship: with congratulations from the jury!
description.ch2x2b: This cup recognizes the participants in the final stages of the 2nd Medium League Clan Championship!
description.ch2x3a: This trophy is to congratulate the winners of the 2nd Clan Championship in the Starter League: we hope to see you in the Medium League next season!
description.ch2x3b: This trophy is a tribute to the participants in the final stages of the 2nd Clan Championship in the Starter League!
description.ch3x1a: The beach and all its pleasures await you! As winners of the Elite League of the 3rd Championship, you can bask in the glory of your victory while sipping a Dinocolada Sunrise, the elixir of winners!
description.ch3x1b: Finishing as a finalist in the Elite League of the 3rd Clan Championship is quite an achievement. Nothing beats a nice little Strawberry Dinocolada to relax after your exploits!
description.ch3x2a: The dedication required to win the Pro League of the 3rd Championship of the Clans deserves to be rewarded. You definitely deserve a Honey Victorcake to get your strength back before the next event!
description.ch3x2b: It takes guts even to sign up for the Pro League of the Championship of the Clans, and even more to get to the final phases of the 3rd Championship! This succulent Pistachio Victorcake makes it all worthwhile.
description.ch3x3a: The dedication required to win the Pro League of the 3rd Championship of the Clans deserves to be rewarded. You definitely deserve a Gilded Caramel Log to get your strength back before the next event!
description.ch3x3b: It takes guts even to sign up for the Amateur League of the Championship of the Clans, and even more to get to the final phases of the 3rd Championship! This tasty Caramel Log makes it all worthwhile.
description.ch3x4a: This trophy is to congratulate the winners of the 3rd Clan Championship in the Starter League: we hope to see you in the Medium League next season!
description.ch3x4b: This trophy is a tribute to the participants in the final stages of the 3rd Clan Championship in the Starter League!
description.ch4x1a: A young and vibrant sun, symbol of power, crowns the winners of the 4th Elite League championship. May the force burn within you until it reaches its peak!
description.ch4x1b: Finalist in the Elite League of the 4th Clan Championship, this sun is offered to you; even at the end of its life, it remains powerful and majestic.
description.ch4x2a: You won the Pro League of the 4th Championship. You must have made sacrifices to get there, so here's a piece of darkness flame as a souvenir.
description.ch4x2b: For reaching the final stages of the Pro League in the 4th Championship, you will receive a blue flame extract.
description.ch4x3a: In winning the Medium League of the 4th Championship, the spirit of fire dwells within you and shows everyone the courage you have demonstrated.
description.ch4x3b: It took a lot of determination to make it to the finals of the Medium League in the 4th Championship. The flame of hope burns within you like never before.
description.ch4x4a: This trophy is to congratulate the winners of the 4th Clan Championship in the Starter League. It is the remains of a powerful fireball.
description.ch4x4b: This trophy is a tribute to the participants in the final stages of the 4th Clan Championship in the Starter League!
description.ch5x1: A young shoot extracted from the vicinity of the Archdorogon Palace is offered to you in recognition of your performance in the 5th Clan Championship.
description.ch5x2: A bonsai tree from the Archdorogon's protected greenhouse is offered to you for winning 5 victories in the 5th Clan Championship.
description.ch5x3: A shrub belonging to the Archdorogon's personal garden is offered to you for winning 6 victories in the 5th Clan Championship.
description.ch5x4: A majestic tree from the sacred gardens of the Archdorogon is offered to you as a reward for your impressive achievement in the 5th Clan Championship.
description.chfx1: This solid gold figurine has been awarded to you for being the most powerful clan in the 6th Clan Championship. It represents raw strength, the absolute power that allowed you to crush your opponents and establish your supremacy.
description.chfx2: This silver-painted figurine was awarded to you for being one of the top 5 clans in the 6th Clan Championship. It represents the skill and wisdom that enabled you to defeat your opponents while remembering that violence is not the only way to battle your adversaries.
description.chfx3: This bronze figurine is given to you as a reward for your performance in the 6th Clan Championship. It represents agility and discipline, which enabled you to defeat your opponents in a flash.
description.chfx4: This plastic figurine was awarded to you for your performance in the 6th Championship of the Clans. It represents courage and self-sacrifice, essential traits necessary for opening the gates to the pantheon of Dinoland!
description.chgx1a: This figurine of a mercenary, selling his services for noble causes, was awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Elite League of the 7th Clan Championship.
description.chgx1b: This figurine of the celestial hero, an extraordinary warrior who fights for peace and destroys high-ranking demons with a single stroke of his sword, is awarded to you for winning the Elite League final of the 7th Clan Championship.
description.chgx2a: This figurine of a sorceress who, thanks to her spells, will render even the fiercest monsters harmless, has been awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Pro League of the 7th Clan Championship.
description.chgx2b: This figurine of a high-ranking elven witch, capable of devastating entire regiments of monsters with her powerful ancestral magic, is your reward for winning the Pro League final of the 7th Clan Championship.
description.chgx3a: This figurine of a martial artist is your reward for participating in the final stages of the Medium League of the 7th Clan Championship.
description.chgx3b: This figurine of a warrior, driven mad by the bloody battles he has fought, is awarded to you for winning the Medium League final of the 7th Clan Championship.
description.chgx4a: This figurine of a retired warrior is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Starter League of the 7th Clan Championship.
description.chgx4b: This figurine of a priest, an indispensable healer in an adventurer's team, is awarded to you for winning the Starter League final of the 7th Clan Championship.
description.chhx1a: This relic of a now-extinct civilization was given to you for participating in the final stages of the Elite League of the 8th Clan Championship. The wear and tear on the object shows that it served for years before finally giving up the ghost.
description.chhx1b: This long-forgotten hobby gadget was a limited edition cast in solid gold. It has been awarded to you for winning the Pro final of the 8th Championship of the clans. This object is extremely precious as it remained in perfect condition over the years.
description.chhx2a: This sculpture has a mysterious aura about it. Just when you think you recognize it, the memory fades away. It is nonetheless awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Pro League of the 8th Clan Championship.
description.chhx2b: This strange sculpture is the product of a disturbed mind, yet it retains an extraordinary aura. It is awarded to you for winning the Pro League final of the 8th Clan Championship.
description.chhx3a: This strange object is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Medium League of the 8th Clan Championship. It is the work of a renowned sculptor who had a fantastical vision of a world ruled by technology...
description.chhx3b: This item must have brought joy to thousands of people in its day. It is being awarded to you for winning the Medium League final of the 8th Clan Championship. If only we knew how to use it.
description.chhx4a: This piece of plastic from an ancient civilization is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Starter League of the 8th Clan Championship. The wear and tear on the object shows that it was used for years before finally giving up the ghost.
description.chhx4b: Originating from an ancient civilization that mastered the art of gaming, this item is awarded to you for winning the Starter League final of the 8th Clan Championship. The item still functions, demonstrating the reliability of the device.
description.chix1a: This relic of a now-extinct civilization was awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Elite League of the 9th Clan Championship. Proof that you can still succeed today, even in blue overalls and a red hat! Warning: causes dizziness and damages the eyes.
description.chix1b: This entertainment machine was awarded to you for winning the Pro League of the 9th Championship of the Clans. Proof positive that it's always possible to succeed, even if you're wearing blue overalls and a red helmet! Warning, causes dizziness and damages sight.
description.chix2a: The rebirth of the monolith, as it was known back then. Still as robust as ever, still as incredible as ever! It is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Pro League of the 9th Clan Championship.
description.chix2b: Once you managed to get the monster working, it was best to enjoy it before it shut down again. It was undoubtedly a luxurious item. It is awarded to you for winning the Pro League final of the 9th Clan Championship.
description.chix3a: This item must have brought joy to thousands of people in its day. It is being awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Medium League of the 9th Clan Championship. A catchy tune resurfaces in your memory... Ta da da da da dada... tuuuut...
description.chix3b: This strange object is given to you for your victory in the Amateur league of the 9th Clan Championship. Some really loved this piece apparently, but personally we don't even know any of them.
description.chix4b: Dating from civilization served in art, this object is given to you for your victory in the Starter League finals of the 5th Clan Championship. On the back there are two hollow places indicating that there might be two cylindrical objects that goes with it... What could they have been?
description.chix4a: This bit of eternal plastic from an oil obsessed civilization is given to you for your participation in the Starter League finals of the 5th Clan Championship. Some say this object contains an archive of the first Dinoz to roam Dinoland, they apparently spent their whole time sleeping...
description.chjx1a: This trophy is given to you in recognition of your participation in the Pro league finals during the 10thClan Championship! A little infusion made from this flower will make you spit fire!
description.chjx1b: This trophy is offered to you for your victory in the finals of the Pro league of the 10th Clan Championship! While you may feel invincible wearing it, don't take any unnecessary risks, lest you fall from on high...
description.chjx2a: This trophy is given to you for your participation in the Amateur league finals during the 6th Clan Championship! A coin so lucky even Buddha's belly can't compare!
description.chjx2b: This trophy is offered to you for your victory in the Amateur league finals of the 10th Clan Championship! Legend has it that those who bite into this friendly little mushroom will double in size for one whole day. Highly sought-after by those measuring less than 1 meter...
description.chjx3a: This trophy is given to you for your participation in the finals of the Amateur league during the 10th Clan Championship! The tortoise that inhabits this shell no longer dares to stick his neck out, for fear of being projected into a wall at speed!
description.chjx3b: This little figuring is offered to you for your victory in the Starter league finals of the 10th Clan Championship! It is said that one can extract tears from this mushroom by jumping on it...
description.chkx1b: You have earned this sword through your participation in the Elite league finals of the 11th Clan Championship. In case any trouble brews with you neighboring Dinoz Master, just flash this baby... That ought to calm things down.
description.chkx1a: This trophy signifies your victory in the Elite league finals of 11th Clan Championship. This will make people think twice when you enter the battle...
description.chkx2b: This object is yours for your participation in the Pro league finals of the 11th Clan Championship. This will settle most arguments... Better to be on your good side.
description.chkx2a: This is yours for your victory in the Pro League finals of the 11th Clan Championship. This shows you for the master strategist that you are. The inexperienced would do well to heed your words.
description.chkx3b: This object is given to you for your participation in the Starter league of the 11th Clan Championship. An object that sums up your participation in one word: Magic!
description.chkx3a: This is only for the winners of the Starter league of the 11th Clan Championship. Your motto in life is: We came, we saw, we conquered. The other clans understood that.
description.chlx1b: This crossbow was awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Elite League of the 13th Clan Championship. An object that still smells of the sweat of its former user, Mr. Tell, can effortlessly launch arrows into orbit.
description.chlx1a: This incredible trophy is awarded to you for winning the Elite League final of the 12th Clan Championship. Apples are good for you, they contain pectin!
description.chlx2b: This item is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Pro League of the 12th Clan Championship. The perfect relic to outshine your enemies, or when you're feeling too hot.
description.chlx2a: A badge of honor. This trophy marks you as the winner of the Pro League in the 12th Clan Championship. The ultimate weapon to hook up during tribal parties.
description.chlx3b: This bow shows your dedication and marks you as a participant in the finals of the Starter League of the 12th Clan Championship. A relic for shooting enthusiasts in naturist areas.
description.chlx3a: Awarded to you for winning the Starter League final of the 12th Clan Championship. A popular bow from the high plateaus of Mongolia, ideal for aquapony archery.
description.chmx1b: This relic was awarded to you for your participation in the finals of the Elite league of the 9th Clan Championship. The frozen claw, to cool down your enemies, or your cola.
description.chmx1a: This incredible trophy is awarded to you for winning the Elite League final of the 13th Clan Championship. A blade made from genuine Indian hemp with a strong scent.
description.chmx2b: This sword is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Pro League of the 13th Clan Championship. Made with an authentic resin shark tooth.
description.chmx2a: Awarded for winning the Pro League final of the 13th Clan Championship. A burning dagger that cuts and sears at the same time, the ideal tool for eating raw meat.
description.chmx3b: This object is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Starter League of the 13th Clan Championship. A simple dagger that points north under certain conditions.
description.chmx3a: Given to you for winning the Starter League final of the 13th Clan Championship. Made of Damascus steel, judging by its smell, it's surely perfect for slicing your sashimi.
description.chnx1b: This relic was awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Elite League of the 14th Clan Championship. A shield that goes perfectly with the lava dagger. Oh, you don't have it? That's a shame...
description.chnx1a: This incredible trophy is awarded to you for winning the Elite League final of the 14th Clan Championship. It belonged to a ridiculous guy in a green suit with pointy ears.
description.chnx2b: This Shield is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Pro League of the 14th Clan Championship. Resistant to holy hand grenades.
description.chnx2a: Awarded for winning the Pro League final of the 14th Clan Championship. Owning this relic gives you an uncontrollable burst of patriotism and an irresistible urge to put on spandex pants.
description.chnx3b: This item is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Starter League of the 14th Clan Championship. Easily deflect Grandma's spittle.
description.chnx3a: Given to you for winning the Starter League final of the 14th Clan Championship. The steel shield is compatible with all induction plates.
description.chox1a: This extremely rare glove is awarded to you for winning the Elite League final of the 15th Clan Championship. An essential accessory for anyone who wants to rescue the princess... who will probably be in another castle.
description.chox1b: This fabulous relic is awarded to you for participating in the final stages of the Elite League of the 15th Clan Championship. Read the instructions carefully before use.
description.chox2a: This legendary relic is awarded to you for winning the Pro League final of the 15th Clan Championship. Possession of this relic grants you the power to fight on equal terms against a celestial creature. If the battle takes place in the city, the manufacturer accepts no responsibility for any collateral damage.
description.chox2b: This glove is given to you for participating in the final stages of the Pro League of the 15th Clan Championship. Putting on this glove generates an irresistible desire for justice.
description.chox3a: This incredible trophy is awarded to you for winning the Starter League final of the 15th Clan Championship. Deliver a punch with the sweet taste of freedom.
description.chox3b: This incredible technique has been unlocked for you for participating in the final stages of the Starter League of the 15th Clan Championship. Victory is yours right out of the box.
description.chpx1a: This honey of Jura roasted turkey is offered to you for winning the Elite League final of the 16th Clan Championship.
description.chpx1b: This braised haunch is offered to you for participating in the final stages of the Elite League of the 16th Clan Championship.
description.chpx2a: This Wild Strawberry Strawberry plant is offered to you for winning the Pro League Final of the 16th Clans Championship.
description.chpx2b: This hot dog from the purest tradition of Chinese street-food is offered to you for having participated in the final stages of the Pro League of the 16th Clans Championship.
description.chpx3a: This incredible trophy is given to you for winning the Starter League Final of the 16th Clan Championship. Biting it gives balm to your heart!
description.chpx3b: This incredible trophy was given to you for participating in the final stages of the Starter League of the 16th Clan Championship. A carrot that gives you a boost!
description.cinec1: This magnificent trophy was awarded to the first winner of the Grand Prize at the first Cinema Paradino Film Festival.
description.cinec2: This magnificent trophy was awarded to the winner of the Cinema Paradino Film Festival Outstanding Contribution Award.
description.cinec3: This magnificent trophy was awarded to the winner of the Cinema Paradino Film Festival Best Parody Award.
description.cinec4: This magnificent trophy was awarded to the winner of the Cinema Paradino Film Festival Best Adaptation Award.
description.hallow: This magnificent trophy was awarded to the winner of the Halloween's parade!
description.tid1: Congratulations on winning the Inter-Dojo Tournament! The Zen Medal rewards the best existing Dojo in Dinoland, no Dinoz master surpasses you! To you the glory, the flashes, the success with the Dinoz masters .... !!
description.tid2: Congratulations on winning the Dinoz Tournament! The solid gold master Zenit figurine is the equivalent of the Oscar of the most valiant master dinoz in all of Dinoland, no master surpasses you! To you the glory, the flashes, the success with the masters / mistresses dinoz.... !!
description.gazeli: The exciting article which you wrote for the Dinoland gazette won you this trophy. Dinoz masters around the world are showing off your work!
description.hunt1: Your achievements during the monster hunt have made you famous. The hunter's soul burns within you and reminds every monster that roams the lands of Dinoland that you are keeping an eye on them.
description.hunint: You were the most formidable hunter in the International Monster Hunt. The soul of a true hunter burns within you and all Dinoz masters who roam the Kingdom of Dinoland are aware of your ascent to legendary status. Time will tell stories of your greatness and bravery.
description.xhunt3: You were the most formidable hunter in the International Monster Hunt. The soul of a true hunter burns within you and all Dinoz masters who roam the Kingdom of Dinoland are aware of your ascent to legendary status. Time will tell stories of your greatness and bravery.
description.xhunt2: You were the second most formidable hunter in the International Monster Hunt. The soul of a true hunter burns within you and all Dinoz masters who roam the Kingdom of Dinoland are aware of your ascent to legendary status. Time will tell stories of your greatness and bravery.
description.xhunt1: You were one of the most formidable hunters in the International Monster Hunt. The soul of a true hunter burns within you and all Dinoz masters who roam the Kingdom of Dinoland are aware of your ascent to legendary status. Time will tell stories of your greatness and bravery.
description.cinema: Your film has been selected by the Dinotown Film Festival jury as the best adventure/melodrama/comedy/mind-blowing/fantastic film. You are one of the best directors who stir our imagination by transporting us to a dreamlike world that only you know how to create!
description.cinem2: Special award from the jury of the Dinotown Film Festival.
description.eugene: Your unparalleled creativity has earned you this magnificent medal, only Dinoz masters with extraordinary intelligence allow themselves to wear it. Some say you're a genius, others say you're a twisted mind, the most important thing is that they are talking about you!
description.litter: This Literature Prize is awarded to you in recognition of your prose, which has moved thousands of Dinoz masters. It will continue to endure through the ages as long as Dinoland does not experience a second catastrophe like the collapse of Jazz Island. Suffice it to say, that won't be anytime soon...
description.clover: You have been awarded this prize for being the owner of the luckiest Dinoz in Dinoland (as selected by the DinoLoto draw)! Congratulations!
description.pac: The Scroll of Compiled Abilities is a sophisticated artifact that lists instantly all the skills mastered by your Dinoz. It gives a clear overview and a detailed breakdown of each talent in one look.
description.card: Grilled to perfection and stamped by the **Merguez Seller** himself, this sacred card rewords the most enduring stomachs. After devouring a nasty amount of merguez, you are now promoted to **Official Grand Glutton**.
description.beta: Congratulations! You have been one of the pioneers of DinoRPG. You are ready to take on new challenges such as this betasaurus. Maybe it's all a mishap in the end?

description.merou_lujidane: A common species in Dinoland and this fish is very popular due to it caramelised taste.
description.poisson_vengeur: It steals leerfish to give to the poor.
description.an_guili_guilille: Most of the Eels are"electric", but this species is refrigerable. People use it to refresh their drinks or to preserve food by wrapping it with them.
description.globulos: Globulos is very soft and sticky but it bounces surprisingly well when thrown against a wall. This funny feature makes it very popular!
description.super_poisson: Defenders of Groupers and Globulos! Nobody really knows the identity of Super-Fish. In fact, no one ever cared... Super-Fish is a greatly unknown hero.
description.touffe_de_fourrure: A handful of good-quality fur! Not enough to make a coat, but it's better than nothing....
description.roche_radio_active: This rock, extracted from the sloughed rock hide of a Groulem, has been affected by exposure to ether and now has a strange glow to it. It's recommended that you don't carry it on your person for any more than a day or you risk losing your hair.
description.griffes_acerees: These claws are less frightening put on a string than on a hairy paw! Make sure you don't hurt yourself.
description.corne_en_chocolat: Although its very rare, sometimes animals are born with a chocolate horn (black or hazelnut chocolate, it depends). Normally these animals don't last long as everybody wants them...
description.oeil_visqueux: This eye makes a really disgusting noise in your bag!
description.langue_monstrueuse: A hunting trophy which would make most Dinoland Masters envious! If in perfect condition, this monster tongue will be sold for a lot of money.
description.energie_foudre: Lightning energy is easy to capture as its all round us. You just have to know how to find it by hitting a stone or moving an iron bar during a thunderstorm.
description.energie_air: In spite of the fact that Air is present everywhere on Dinoland, only certain breezes can be transformed in pure energy.
description.energie_eau: Water Energy can be found on every water surface, but they move so quickly that nobody ever succeeds in capturing them! This is why their price is so high.
description.energie_feu: Fire in its natural state is very valuable.
description.energie_bois: If finding a tree is an easy, then harboring Wood Energy is near impossible! You have often to climb high in the leaves to find it...
description.silex_taille: A sharpened pebble by who-knows-who to do who-knows-what.
description.fragment_de_texte_ancien: The text engraved on this fragment is unreadable. But you can be sure that a collector will pay well to get it.
description.vieil_anneau_precieux: This gold ring dates back hundreds of years and would be a beautiful exhibit in a museum
description.calice_cisele: This Chalice, in the old days, was part of a whole crockery collection (you are free to find the rest). You are impatient to put your hand on the cauldron!
description.collier_karat: This superb piece instantly bestows its wearer with both class and elegance.
description.broche_en_parfait_etat: You're incredibly lucky! This highly valuable brooch is like new, despite its age.
description.superbe_couronne_royale: This extremely rare crown was once worn by the King of Dinoland.
description.feuilles_de_pelinae: Pelinae is liked for the fresh perfume it emits, it can be found in houses throughout Dinoland.
description.bolet_phalisk_blanc: A Mushroom of the Mushgood family, which is easy to cook in a green sauce. Some prefer it in omelettes, others like it in soup, but everybody agrees on the fact that pan-fried Phalisk Boletus is delicious.
description.orchidee_fantasque: An improbable fusion between rare Orchids. It generally grows upside down, covered by a layer of hair which gives it camouflage properties.
description.racine_de_figonicia: Figonicia is a bad-tempered plant. That's the reason why its root are so exposed, it prevents them from growing again.
description.sadiquae_mordicus: Sadiquae Mordicus is very dangerous! Often many meters high, they can digest a human in less than a few hours. At an early age, the worst they can do is eat one of your fingers.
description.flaureole: Pickye Deftlyna is only found on Nimbao. Very difficult to pick, the slightest wrong move and it launches heavenward...
description.spore_etheral: The Ethereal Spore grows on the Caushemesh islands thanks to the eher that runs across their rock. Although inedible, it does give off a pleasant smell if prepared properly.
description.pousse_sombre: The dark fruit relies on the darkness surrounding it for nourishment. Once it comes into contact with sunlight, it desintegrates extremely quickly. It's best to be careful with it and never let it see daylight. Once it has been dried though, it can be conserved for several years.
description.graine_de_devoreuse: Devourer seeds are very rare ingredients which can only be found in the Magnetic Steppes. More important than their rarity, they are highly desired by the finest gourmets, renderring them invaluable.
description.dent_de_dorogon: Very few people can claim to own this particular hunting trophy! This freshly extracted Dorogon Tooth should fetch a nice price.
description.bras_mecanique: This artifact resembles a hand, it must have been made using some forgotten technology, and even if it doesn't work any more, it still has great value...
